problem: Clipboard promises set copyStatus unconditionally after mint editing, Clear, or a new derivation resets that status. The live-region and visible feedback can revert to an older context.
fix: Advance one operation generation on copy, mint edit, Clear and derive; update success/failure feedback only for current generation. Browser clipboard completion itself is not cancelled.
newCases: Late success after a new derivation
qualification: Static candidate only; baseline and candidate browser outcomes pending. No SDK/RPC/API/auth/claim/style changes.
